name: Cross-Ecosystem Food Web & Terrestrial Predator Bridge
design_rules: cross-ecosystem feeding transfers pressure between existing populations and resources
predation cannot create biomass or individuals
drying and shoreline loss reduce cross-ecosystem feeding intensity
terrestrial predators may hunt at shorelines only when prey is locally available
fish may consume shoreline-derived insects when habitat overlap permits
cross-ecosystem state persists across world days
cross-ecosystem ecology never uses emissive or glow feedback
